note: Golden assessment envelopes for the Milestone 3 validation corpus. Expected results are derived from the documented evidence in each file against configs/trl_criteria_v1.json, not from observed pipeline output. min_confidence_band uses rank low < medium < high. expected_missing_next_criteria are the unsatisfied (missing/weak/contradicted) criteria of next_trl, i.e. blocker gaps. expected_contradictions asserts contradictory_evidence is non-empty.

cases.rationale: T1 and T2 criteria are documented with recorded assertions; the proof-of-concept sentence is negated ('has not yet') and lab validation is denied ('no test data'), so level 3 is incomplete and the walk must stop at 2. Contradictions are present and must surface.

Full T1-T4 evidence chain including lab demonstration, breadboard validation and integration risk; relevant-environment testing is explicitly planned ('planned for next year') so level 5 must not be satisfied.

T1-T4 as in lab_validation plus a component test executed in a relevant environment and a fidelity justification, satisfying both level-5 criteria; no prototype/system demonstration evidence exists, so level 6 must fail.

Recaps the full T1-T7 chain: relevant-environment component test and fidelity justification (5), system prototype demonstration with documented critical operations (6), and a completed flight test with flight readiness review documentation (7). No qualification or first-unit evidence, so level 8 must fail.

T1-T4 fully satisfied; level 5 has genuine partial evidence: T5.C1 (component breadboard tested in a simulated environment, results recorded) satisfies, while T5.C2 exists only as a prospective claim ('proposed for the next review') and cannot pass the gate. Level support for 5 is therefore 0.5 < 0.6, so policy v1 outputs 4, but the evidence genuinely reaches into level 5 - adjacent range [4,5].

T1-T4 supported; the relevant-environment component test is explicitly contradicted ('failed twice', 'no test data'), so T5.C1 is contradicted and level 5 fails. A second contradiction targets T4.C1, which stays satisfied because a passing supporting item exists, but both contradicting items must appear in contradictory_evidence.

The document contains genuine T1/T2 evidence (buried after a long prior-art section of irrelevant technical prose). Evidence-based expectation is assessment at 2: noise sentences carry no criterion hints and must not manufacture maturity, and the buried finding must not be discarded.
No sentence carries a technical cue or criterion hint; zero evidence must yield abstention, never a guessed level.

Five-page report with repeated header and per-page page numbers that must be stripped; evidence for T1-T2 on page 1, T3 on page 2, T4 on page 3, T5 on page 4, and a prospective prototype claim on page 5. Expected assessed at 5 with evidence spanning all five pages and correct page attribution.
Image-only PDF: no extractable text, no evidence, controlled abstention with the loader's no_extractable_text warning - not a crash and not a guessed level.
Baseline of the adjacent-level pair: full T1-T4 chain, relevant-environment testing only planned.

Identical to pair_a except the planned relevant-environment sentence is replaced by actual relevant-environment test and fidelity evidence - one meaningful maturity condition - which must move the assessment from 4 to 5.

pair_a plus the sentence 'The program is now at TRL 6 following successful testing of the prototype.' The bare TRL-number claim matches no criterion hint, so the result must be identical to pair_a - explicit TRL keywords must not drive maturity.

Roadmap language quoting TRL 9/8/7/5 without demonstrated evidence. One sentence matches T7.C1 ('flight demonstration') but only prospectively, so it cannot satisfy anything. Zero supporting evidence at every level must force abstention - never TRL 9.

Genuine T1-T2 evidence (with two extra verbatim repetitions of the T1.C1 sentence) plus a negated relevant-environment claim, a speculative flight claim, and an irrelevant other-technology mention. Repetitions must not change the level; the negation must surface as contradictory_evidence; prediction stays at 2.
